name: Google AI Studio
summary: Google's web tool to prototype and build with Gemini models.
description: Google AI Studio is a browser-based environment to experiment with Gemini models, vibe-code apps, and obtain API keys for the Gemini API. It is the fastest path from prompt to production for developers using Google models. Use of AI Studio and the Gemini API free tier costs nothing, with paid API tiers billed per token and higher limits included in Google AI plans.
